nina (sample-app): Heads up — our onboarding smoke tests started failing this morning. The JS sample-app is getting an embedding vector of length 1024 but the Python local reranker (used in the test harness) asserts 1536 and raises. Also the rerank response shape changed and our tiny in-process reranker choked.

nina (sample-app): From network capture (embeddings):
```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-embed-lite\",
  \"embedding\": [0.12, -0.03, ...],
  \"meta\": {\"commit\": \"a1b2c3\", \"timestamp\": \"2026-03-15T09:01:02Z\"}
}
```

leo (sdk): Which SDK versions are you running? we recently shipped a change to prefer a smaller embed profile for low-cost endpoints.

nina (sample-app): JS sdk 0.9.8 (sample-app starter), py sdk pinned to 0.10.1. The sample-app quickstart pins alias `embed:latest` which apparently flipped to the lite profile overnight.

maya (ml infra): Yep that alias got remapped as part of a performance rollout. We should have chronicled that better in the model catalog. That explains dim change. We can add an explicit `embedding_dim` field in the response and in the catalog.

owen (eng-runtime): FTR rerank shape changed to support per-batch scores and heuristic metadata. New shape is `{ batches: [{ items: [...], scores: [...], batch_id }], summary: { total } }` vs old `[{id,score,doc}]`. We thought that would be non-breaking but I see how small local code breaks. We can add a compat endpoint param `compat=legacy` and emit a deprecation header.

leo (sdk): SDK action items: (1) read embedding length from payload and avoid hardfail; (2) expose a small helper `normalizeEmbedding(vec, targetDim)` built-in to SDK utilities; (3) add graceful fallback for rerank shape. I can open PRs.

nina (sample-app): Example helper I hacked in the test runner (JS):
```js
// embed-helper.js
export function adaptEmbedding(vec, desired) {
  if (!Array.isArray(vec)) throw new Error('bad vec');
  if (vec.length === desired) return vec;
  if (vec.length < desired) return vec.concat(new Array(desired-vec.length).fill(0));
  return vec.slice(0, desired);
}
```
Also a quick converter for rerank:
```js
function rerankCompatibility(resp) {
  if (Array.isArray(resp)) return resp; // already legacy
  // flatten first batch for old clients
  const first = resp.batches && resp.batches[0];
  return (first && first.items.map((it, i) => ({ id: it.id, score: first.scores[i], doc: it.doc }))) || [];
}
```
Works locally but we'd prefer proper SDK support.

leo (sdk): Another SDK concern: auth/retry parity. Node quickstart uses ephemeral tokens via the CLI and expects the SDK to call a user-provided `refreshToken()` hook on 401. Current behavior: SDK surfaces 401 immediately (we only auto-retry on 429/5xx). We should expose `onAuthFailure` callback and also support automatic refresh if provided. I'll include that in the PR.

owen (eng-runtime): We can add an `x-rw-retry-advice: auth-refresh` header on 401 responses where server-side session can be quietly refreshed. That will help SDKs decide. For alias remaps I can add `x-rw-model-dim: 1024` header until infra adds top-level field.

maya (ml infra): I'll add `embedding_dim` to the canonical model response and update the catalog. Also adding an audit log event when aliases are remapped so we can alert devex/sample-app.

ci-bot: PR opened by leo: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-js/pulls/412 (adds adaptEmbedding and onAuthFailure hook)

nina (sample-app): Huge improvement. Can we also update quickstart docs to recommend pinning a numeric model version for reproducibility? The alias flips will keep biting users.

leo (sdk): Good call — we'll update quickstart + changelog to recommend pinning and to show how to call `normalizeEmbedding`. I'll include a migration note for rerank shape.

maya (ml infra): Plan of record:
- add `embedding_dim` in embedding response + model catalog entry (maya)
- emit `x-rw-model-dim` header as short-term stopgap (now)
- add alias remap audit events + notify sample-app team (maya)
- runtime to add `compat=legacy` param and deprecation header for rerank (owen)
- SDKs to read dynamic dims, add normalize helper, add onAuthFailure hook + docs (leo)
- sample-app tests updated to assert on `embedding_dim` and to pin model in quickstart (nina)

nina (sample-app): Thanks — I pushed a branch with the test changes and a temp fix using adaptEmbedding. Will remove once SDK release is out.

leo (sdk): I'll try to get the SDK change into the 0.9.x minor (nonbreaking). We'll also add an integration test that fires both shapes for rerank.

owen (eng-runtime): I'll land the compat param tomorrow and add the header guidance.

nina (sample-app): Great. Appreciate the fast turnaround. Leaving this thread open until PRs are merged. :sparkles:
